# Devtacet — Digital Studio

> Devtacet is a full-service digital studio specializing in mobile app development, high-performance websites, custom data analytics tools, and AI & technical SEO marketing.

## Core Specializations & Services

- **Mobile App Development**: iOS and Android app development using React Native & Flutter. Built for rapid app store approval, fluid UI, and scale.
- **Website Development**: High-performance web applications, e-commerce, and marketing sites built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Optimized for sub-second load times and conversions.
- **Data Analytics Tools**: Custom analytical dashboards, data pipelines, automated reporting, and decision-support systems turning raw business data into actionable insights.
- **SEO & AI Marketing (GEO)**: Technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI overview optimization, content strategy, and keyword growth that drives organic search acquisition.

## Key Facts & Capabilities

- **Website URL**: https://devtacet.me
- **Primary Tech Stack**: Next.js 15+, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, React Native, Flutter, MongoDB / Mongoose.
- **Client Engagement**: Direct collaboration with senior engineers and product designers without middle-tier proxy managers.
- **Deliverables**: End-to-end digital product design, architecture, code development, launch, and search engine optimization.
